_comment: Groups short test configs into shared CI jobs (tests/oot_framework/utils/test_layout.py). Timings come from .github/test_timings.json, regenerated by tests/scripts/refresh_test_timings.py. A config with fewer than min_runs recorded runs (e.g. a new one) runs as its own job until it has them. Delete this file to run every config as its own job again.
